declarations.description: One chip in a `ui-chip-group`. `removable` defaults to true and shows the remove button. Set the property to false to hide the button; that chip does not emit `remove`. `detail.value` is the `value` attribute, or the trimmed text content when `value` is omitted. The chip stays in the DOM. No public methods.
declarations.name: UiChip

members.name: value
members.description: Identifier sent with `remove`. Falls back to the trimmed label when omitted.

members.name: removable
members.description: Shows the remove button. Set to false to keep the chip from emitting `remove`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Identifier sent with `remove`. Falls back to the trimmed label when omitted.

attributes.name: removable
attributes.description: Shows the remove button. Set the property to false to hide it. The chip does not emit `remove`.

events.name: remove
events.description: Bubbles and is composed. Fired from the remove button when `removable` is true. `detail.value` is the `value` attribute, or the trimmed text content when `value` is omitted. The chip stays in the DOM.

slots.description: Chip label. The remove button's accessible name is `Remove {label}`.
